acceptance_criterion.claim: selected candidate is worth experimental validation
acceptance_criterion.criterion: compare its measured 120 C hold behavior with the original references
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: candidate shows clearly worse hold drift than the original reference formulations

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Exact one-third-scaled analogue of E2, whose 120 C viscosity was substantially higher and more variable than E1 in the supplied temperature measurements.
Exact one-third-scaled analogue of E5, which showed much larger 120 C hold drift than E1 from 15 to 60 minutes.

selection_rationale: S1C01 is the exact one-third-scaled analogue of E1, which had the lowest supplied 120 C hold drift: viscosity increased from 708.7 at 15 minutes to 776.1 at 60 minutes. This makes it the most directly supported candidate for validation, while recognizing that candidate hold behavior is unmeasured.

evidence_coverage.note: Only original-formulation temperature and limited hold data are available.

extrapolation.note: Selection extrapolates from original formulations to compositionally scaled candidates.

measurement.note: No 120 C hold measurement is supplied for any candidate.

process_history.note: Candidate processing history is not supplied.
